europe_now.title: US Envoys Arrive in Moscow for Ukraine Negotiations
europe_now.summary: American diplomatic representatives have traveled to Moscow to hold discussions with Vladimir Putin regarding the ongoing conflict in Ukraine. The talks follow previous diplomatic engagement aimed at addressing the crisis.

sources.headline: US envoys arrive in Moscow for Ukraine talks with Vladimir Putin

europe_now.title: Poland Indicts Individual on Sabotage Charges
europe_now.summary: Polish authorities have formally indicted a Ukrainian man accused of assisting in rail sabotage operations on behalf of Russia. The case highlights ongoing concerns regarding regional hybrid security threats and infrastructure protection.

sources.headline: Poland indicts Ukrainian man for assisting in rail sabotage on behalf of Russia

top_stories.title: Energy Grid Strikes and Blackouts in Ukraine
top_stories.summary: Recent Russian military strikes targeting energy infrastructure have caused severe blackouts across Ukraine, leaving residents struggling without light, water, or heat. Officials report that the national power supply is operating close to critical thresholds.

sources.headline: Ukraine's power supply close to critical as Russian strikes bring darkness and cold

top_stories.title: Mass Demonstrations and General Strike in Spain
top_stories.summary: Millions of participants joined Spain's first general strike in fourteen years to protest widespread economic pressures and housing costs. Demonstrations in various urban areas escalated into clashes between protesters and security personnel.

sources.headline: Millions join Spain's first general strike in 14 years as anger over housing leads to clashes
